title: College Football
desc: The No. 17 Cougars meet the Bearcats at TDECU Stadium for a Big 12 game. Houston leans on nine third-down conversions from a 6-2 start, while 5-3 Cincinnati counts on three team sacks and two takeaways from an Oct. 31 game to secure a Big 12 victory.

title: College Football
desc: The No. 8 UCLA Bruins (8-0) face the Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-3) at Huntington Bank Stadium for a Big Ten game. UCLA enters undefeated in eight games after shutting out Nevada 27-0, while Minnesota is coming off a 23-16 overtime defeat to Indiana.

title: College Football
desc: The Rainbow Warriors (2-6, 1-4) visit the Miners (1-7, 0-4) for a Mountain West affair. The programs haven't met since 2004, when they were Western Athletic Conference foes. Hawaii traveled 4,255 miles to beat Northern Illinois 56-21 last week.

title: College Football
desc: The Bears (5-3, 3-2 Big 12) brace for Aiden Flora and the Cyclones (4-4, 2-3). Baylor leads the series 12-11 after Iowa State prevailed 43-21 in 2024. Flora rushed for 221 yards and two touchdowns in a 51-49 triumph over Oklahoma State last week.
